topics.label: Lecture introduction to complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture and frames the importance and complexity of the complement system.

topics.label: Complement fundamentals and the central role of C3
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish the foundational organization, nomenclature, and pivotal role of C3 in the complement cascade.

topics.label: Pathways of complement activation and trigger threshold
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the three recognition pathways that drive complement activation and converge on the C3 convertase threshold.

topics.label: Complement effector mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the downstream effector functions through which activated complement destroys pathogens and drives inflammation.

topics.label: Regulation of complement and host protection
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the mechanisms and regulatory proteins host cells use to prevent complement-mediated self-damage.

topics.label: Clinical consequences of complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explores how deficiencies in specific complement components or regulators manifest clinically as disease.

topics.label: Pathogen evasion of the complement system
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the evolutionary mechanisms pathogens employ to resist and evade destruction by complement.

topics.label: Lecture wrap-up and conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding remarks for the lecture and previews the next topic in the course.
